proposals.name: 緊湊卡片
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity concept reference for the party skill settings panel of a Traditional Chinese classic PC Lineage idle game. Create a single polished UI proposal, front-on flat screen, portrait presentation. Preserve the visual language of original classic Lineage: restrained dark charcoal/slate panels, old bronze thin frames, warm yellow names, cyan attack labels, green healing labels, muted violet conversion labels, blue checked checkboxes, native-looking square buttons. No modern SaaS white cards, no neon, no new logos, no watermark. Use anonymous names only: 法師甲（法師）Lv.37, 妖精乙（妖精）Lv.37, 騎士丙（騎士）Lv.37. Text is Taiwan Traditional Chinese, clear and legible. Title 技能設定. Keep text compact, single-line control labels, align fields and numerical thresholds, make good use of horizontal space; no redundant large headers. Retain genuine controls: attack dropdown 燃燒的火球 MP>50%, healing dropdown 無 HP<43%, conversion dropdown 魔力奪取 for mage; 三重矢 MP>70%, 無 HP<70%, 靈魂轉換 for elf; knight uses 無. Potion gates HP<63%喝水 and HP<30%停技 for mage, HP<56%喝水 and HP<0%停技 for elf. Auto-maintenance label 自動維持（增益／召喚／回復／淨化）. Include a realistic mix of checked and unchecked skills: 日光術、保護罩、神聖武器、解毒術、擬似魔法武器、負重強化、體甲護持、無所遁形術、加速術、冥想術、通暢氣脈術、聖潔之光、體魄強健術、召喚術、魔法相消術、強力加速術、聖結界、狂暴術. Do not show any real player identifiers. These are design references, not screenshots or functional code.
Proposal A — Compact stacked cards. Show three vertically stacked character cards. All settings remain visible at once. Each card has a thin one-line character name/class/level header, three aligned horizontal rows for attack/healing/conversion, potion/pause gates in one balanced row, and consistent tightly packed checkbox chips in clean aligned columns. Keep the original game's card structure while reducing wasted spacing and inconsistent checkbox sizing. This is the conservative refinement option. Entire first two cards visible, third card visibly starts at bottom. Small caption A · 緊湊卡片.
